posts.body_html:
Sorry guys! I tried to distribute purple throated oreophilas via the ICPS last year, but there wasn't enough interest, and we had to move 2 times, so I didn't want to over commit to the project. I am donating a good amount of genetically diverse S. oreophila seeds from my Cherokee Co, AL population to the ICPS seedbank this year, so it'll be your first chance to legally obtain some impossible to get oreophilas.

For those of you in California, we're very spoiled and have access to almost everything. Be sure to take advantage of your situation, as everyone else in the rest of the 49 states don't have the same opportunity.
